notes: The 2026 TDHCA index lists 202 incorporated municipalities assigned to metro counties and 19 CDPs. Four additional cross-boundary municipalities were identified from NCTCOG GIS polygon intersection.
The NCTCOG organizations directory is insufficient alone: it omits some newer incorporations and has missing county fields.
Municipal websites are source-reported discovery links, not individually verified URLs.
No population, ZIP codes, landmarks, neighborhoods, or crew locations are inferred from geography.
The NCTCOG 228-cities figure describes the broader 16-county region, not the 11-county MSA.
MSA definition: July 21, 2023 OMB delineations. Some other official documents carry older 13-county definitions; do not mix those boundaries.
All 206 GEOIDs were cross-checked against Census January 1, 2025 incorporated-place records.
